title: Vibrant Roasted Filipino Vegetable Skewers
description: A solo dinner dish featuring roasted Filipino vegetables with a twist of Branston pickle and Nuka pickle, perfect for a quick and healthy meal. This dish is vegetarian friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the bell peppers, onions, and zucchini onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped Branston pickle and Nuka pickle.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, brush the skewers with the pickle mixture and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional pickle mixture if desired.
